scope: G0-G12 Cross-series Editorial Sweep; not a C++ or PDF validation run
audit_script: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """One-shot, read-only editorial preservation audit; no C++ execution.""" import hashlib import json import re import subprocess import sys from pathlib import Path ROOT = Path.cwd().resolve() BASE = "b4728e36f307eb4e4c639cdd1300ef7b33f8c929" def sha(raw): return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() def digest(value): return sha(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode()) def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT) def sections(text): blocks, outside, buf = [], [], None for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True): if line.startswith("```"): if buf is None: buf = [line] else: buf.append(line) blocks.append("".join(buf)) buf = None elif buf is not None: buf.append(line) else: outside.append(line) assert buf is None, "unclosed fence" prose = "".join(outside) headers = re.findall(r"^#{1,3} .+$", prose, re.M) anchors = re.findall(r'', prose) markers = re.findall(r"", prose) identities = re.findall(r"^\[(?:完整实验|机制片段|反例)[^\n]+$", prose, re.M) gates = [] headings = list(re.finditer(r"^## .+$", text, re.M)) for index, h in enumerate(headings): if "Final Gate" not in h.group(): continue end = headings[index + 1].start() if index + 1 < len(headings) else len(text) body = text[h.end():end] # G0/G1 place their completion note and references after the answers. body = body.split("**完成标准：**")[0] gates.append(body) return dict(blocks=blocks, headers=headers, anchors=anchors, markers=markers, identities=identities, gates=gates) def compare(old, new): a, b = sections(old), sections(new) return {key: a[key] == b[key] for key in a} # Deterministic self-controls: accept prose edits, reject changed program/Gate/anchor. fixture = '# H\n\n\n\n## 1. Text\nprose\n\n```cpp\nint x = 1;\n```\n\n## 2. Final Gate\n1. Why?\n' controls = { "prose_edit_allowed": all(compare(fixture, fixture.replace("prose", "edited prose")).values()), "code_edit_rejected": not compare(fixture, fixture.replace("x = 1", "x = 2"))["blocks"], "gate_edit_rejected": not compare(fixture, fixture.replace("Why?", "What?"))["gates"], "anchor_edit_rejected": not compare(fixture, fixture.replace('id="x"', 'id="y"'))["anchors"], } assert all(controls.values()) chapters = sorted((ROOT / "c++").glob("g[0-1][0-9]-*.md")) assert len(chapters) == 13 rows = [] for i, path in enumerate(chapters): rel = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() old_raw = git("show", f"{BASE}:{rel}") new_raw = path.read_bytes() old, new = old_raw.decode(), new_raw.decode() checks = compare(old, new) assert all(checks.values()), (rel, checks) parts = sections(new) assert len(parts["gates"]) == 2, rel assert "**版本：** " + ("1.2.1" if i <= 4 else "1.1.1") in new assert "[全书术语、证据与引用](handbook-guide.md)" in new if i: assert f"[上一章：G{i-1}]({chapters[i-1].name})" in new if i < 12: assert f"[下一章：G{i+1}]({chapters[i+1].name})" in new rows.append(dict(path=rel, base_sha256=sha(old_raw), current_sha256=sha(new_raw), checks=checks, blocks=len(parts["blocks"]), headers=len(parts["headers"]), anchors=len(parts["anchors"]), lab_markers=len(parts["markers"]), visible_identities=len(parts["identities"]), gate_sections=len(parts["gates"]), code_blocks_sha256=digest(parts["blocks"]), gate_sections_sha256=digest(parts["gates"]))) tracked = [p.decode() for p in git("ls-tree", "-rz", "--name-only", BASE).split(b"\0") if p] allowed = {r["path"] for r in rows} | {"c++/README.md", "c++/learning/README.md"} protection = [] for rel in tracked: raw, original = (ROOT / rel).read_bytes(), git("show", f"{BASE}:{rel}") equal = raw == original assert equal or rel in allowed, rel protection.append(dict(path=rel, base_sha256=sha(original), current_sha256=sha(raw), unchanged=equal)) snapshot_paths = sorted(allowed | {"c++/editorial-profile.md", "c++/handbook-guide.md"}) snapshot = [dict(path=p, bytes=len((ROOT/p).read_bytes()), sha256=sha((ROOT/p).read_bytes())) for p in snapshot_paths] sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "c++/learning")) import verify_g, verify_handbook, verify_native, verify_synthesis extraction = [] for module, group in [(verify_g, chapters[:5]), (verify_handbook, chapters[5:8]), (verify_native, chapters[8:10]), (verify_synthesis, chapters[10:12])]: old_docs = [(p.name, git("show", f"{BASE}:{p.relative_to(ROOT)}").decode()) for p in group] new_docs = [(p.name, p.read_text()) for p in group] old_labs, new_labs = module.extract(old_docs), module.extract(new_docs) assert old_labs == new_labs, module.__name__ for lab in new_labs: extraction.append(dict(runner=module.__name__, id=lab["id"], document=lab["document"], mode=lab["mode"], oracle_and_files_equal=True, files={p: sha(s.encode()) for p, s in lab["files"].items()})) reference_inventory = [] for path in chapters + [ROOT / "c++/handbook-guide.md"]: for url in sorted(set(re.findall(r"\]\((https?://[^)]+)\)", path.read_text()))): assert "ziglang.org/documentation/master" not in url assert "doc.rust-lang.org/" not in url or "doc.rust-lang.org/1.85.0/" in url reference_inventory.append(dict(path=path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), url=url)) print(json.dumps(dict(base=BASE, audit_self_controls=controls, chapters=rows, totals=dict(chapters=len(rows), blocks=sum(r["blocks"] for r in rows), anchors=sum(r["anchors"] for r in rows), gate_sections=sum(r["gate_sections"] for r in rows), lab_markers=sum(r["lab_markers"] for r in rows), labs=len(extraction), extracted_files=sum(len(r["files"]) for r in extraction), tracked=len(tracked), unchanged=sum(r["unchanged"] for r in protection)), protection=protection, extraction=extraction, source_snapshot=dict(status="FROZEN_CANDIDATE_FOR_REVIEW", files=snapshot), external_reference_inventory=reference_inventory), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
